_note: appUrl: the public address people open (used by Share). analyticsUrl: the Cloudflare Worker /e endpoint from server/README.md. Empty analyticsUrl = counts stay queued on the phone and nothing is sent.
_home: Order of the blocks on the home screen. Remove a name to hide it. Available: emergency (the big red Emergency button: age picker, then first-aid pages), install, ask, nextVaccine, sections, quick, tools (breathing counter and 'what does the number mean?'), kit (home health kit), near, share (the Share Sehat card; 'sendApp' is its older name), growth (the growth tracker tile), feedback, disclaimer.
_shareCard: The Share Sehat card on the home screen: opens the share screen (js/share.js). title/sub are ui text keys, say is the narration id; webSub/webSay are used in a browser instead of the Android app.
_quickTools: Tool rows added by features (id, link, icon, ui text key for the label, narration id). growth: the growth tracker (js/growth.js).
_feedbackUrl: The Cloudflare Worker /feedback address (same server as analyticsUrl).
_contentUrl: The Cloudflare Worker address (no /e at the end), e.g. https://family-health-book.<you>.workers.dev. When set, phones also download the book published from the dashboard editor (/admin) when they are online. Empty = only the book built into the app.
_urgentTopics: Topics whose narration downloads first (the 'urgent' audio pack), together with the interface lines, every topic title and every red 'go to hospital now' box. The other clips download in packs by section: children, women, everyone.
_consentMode: Usage counts: "ask" = one narrated yes/no screen on first open and nothing is sent unless they say yes; "on" = a one-time notice, and counts are sent unless they switch them off. Both modes have a switch in Settings. Disease-watch questions only show while counts are allowed.
_consentVersion: Version of the consent wording (ui.consent, ui.consentOn, ui.privacy.*). Stored on the phone with the answer and sent with every upload. Change it when the wording changes: in "ask" mode every phone is asked again.
_emergency: The Emergency screen (home button): one row per age. label = a ui.text key; cpr = the 'not breathing' page shown first in red; anim = the CPR animation it plays; topics = 'Other emergencies' for that age, in order. See docs/EMERGENCIES.md section 4.
